title: Scotland Edge Past Haiti 1-0 at Gillette Stadium
excerpt: Group C action from Boston — Day 3 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup
body:
## Haiti 0-1 Scotland
*Group C · Gillette Stadium, Boston*

Scotland snatched the win in a closely contested Group C match, edging Haiti 1-0 at Gillette Stadium. It was a game of slim margins and hard tackles, the kind of World Cup fixture where one moment of quality makes all the difference.

The result is a blow for Haiti but not a fatal one. With two group games remaining, there is time to recover — but the margin for error has narrowed.

Gillette Stadium in the Greater Boston area hosted the match. The region's strong desi community — bolstered by the tech and university corridors from Cambridge to Route 128 — brought their energy to the stands.
